meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for all caveman modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /caveman-help, "caveman help", "what caveman commands", "how do I use caveman".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 速查全部模式、技能与命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常记不住可用命令或想了解全部功能
copy.tagline_en: Look up all modes, skills, and commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget the available commands or want to see all features

howto.what: 被触发时,Claude 会当场用 caveman 风格显示一张速查卡,汇总所有模式、技能和命令;只展示一次,不切换模式、不写入文件、不保留任何设置。
howto.when: 当用户输入“/caveman-help”“caveman help”“what caveman commands”等触发词,或询问怎么使用 caveman 时触发。

say.text: 给我看 caveman 的速查卡
say.note: 会显示模式、技能与命令清单。
英文触发词也能唤起速查卡。
会以 caveman 风格列出可用命令。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude instantly displays a quick-reference card in caveman style, summarizing all modes, skills, and commands. One-shot only: no mode change, no files written, no persistent settings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user types "/caveman-help", "caveman help", "what caveman commands", or asks how to use caveman.

say_en.text: Show me the caveman quick-reference card.
say_en.note: Displays list of modes, skills, commands.
Lists available commands in caveman style.
